BrochureContent.Content:
2 Bedroom Traditional Farm Cottage on 14.8 Acres located at Glasshouse, Blue Ball, Tullamore, Co. Offaly.

A Rare Countryside Restoration Opportunity

TOM MCDONALD & ASSOCIATES - EXPERIENCED, PROFESSIONAL, TRUSTED are pleased to offer to the market this unique residential farm holding.
 
Set amidst approximately 14.8 acres of rolling countryside, this traditional two-bedroom farm cottage offers a unique opportunity to restore and reimagine a charming rural home in a peaceful and scenic setting.

The property includes a character filled old farmhouse together with traditional stone outbuildings, all requiring refurbishment, making it an ideal project for those seeking a country lifestyle, hobby farm, equestrian property, or redevelopment opportunity subject to the necessary planning permissions.

_____

The Cottage

The farmhouse retains the charm and character of a traditional rural dwelling and offers enormous scope for restoration. While in need of upgrading throughout, the property presents a blank canvas for buyers wishing to create a bespoke countryside residence.

Accommodation comprises:
•	Living room 
•	Kitchen area 
•	Two bedrooms 
•	Bathroom 

The cottage benefits from a tranquil setting with uninterrupted countryside views and excellent privacy.

Vacant/Derelict Grants available for Cottage/Farmhouse subject to approval.
______

Stone Outbuildings

A notable feature of the property is the range of traditional stone outbuildings, which offer substantial potential for a variety of uses including storage, workshops, studios, or possible conversion opportunities subject to planning permission.

_____

The Land

Extending to approximately 14.8 acres, the lands are suitable for grazing, hobby farming, small scale agriculture, or equestrian activities. The surrounding countryside provides a peaceful and attractive setting with mature hedgerows and natural landscape features.

____

Location

Situated in a quiet rural area yet within convenient reach of nearby towns and local amenities, this property combines the appeal of country living with accessibility.

Located a short drive to the Tullamore/Birr Road, N52 and the R357 which links the nearby towns and villages.

Let's make it yours!

For further information or to arrange a viewing, contact us on 057 8623643.

•	Traditional 2-bedroom farmhouse cottage 
•	Requires refurbishment and modernisation 
•	Vacant/Derelict Grants available for Cottage/Farmhouse subject to approval 
•	Collection of original stone outbuildings 
•	Situated on approximately 14.8 acres 
•	Services include mains water, well, septic tank, electricity
•	Quiet and private rural location 
•	Excellent renovation and redevelopment potential 
•	Suitable for hobby farming or equestrian use 
•	Mature natural boundaries and scenic views 
•	Genuine lifestyle and investment opportunity 
•	Situated adjacent to the L20113, Ballyfarrell Road which networks with the local roads, townlands and villages in the midlands of Ireland
•	Tullamore - 12km, Kilcormac - 11km, Birr - 27km
